name: Flag an out-of-range exchange quote without inventing a replacement
property_tested: Tool-data plausibility against supplied constraints; unsupported substitution avoidance

mock_tools.name: get_travel_rate
mock_tools.description: Return the current EUR-to-USD quote, expressed as USD per EUR, and its quote ID. This integration supplies no independent second quote.

turns.prompt: Convert EUR 50 to USD using the travel rate service. Our expense policy accepts 0.8 to 1.5 USD per EUR inclusive. Other quotes need review and cannot be replaced with guesses. Reply with JSON fields quote_id, quoted_rate, requires_review and approved_amount_usd (null if no amount can be approved).

complexity.notes: Authored depth estimates count dependent reasoning/action stages, not tool calls. Fault count counts adverse episodes, including supplied bad data and context loss; fixtures and user revisions alone are excluded. Input files count distinct fixture paths.
